I'm checking each square object's size parity to determine its interior fill value—even-sized squares get one color, odd-sized ones another—then reconsidering whether the fill applies to the border cells themselves rather than the interior.

Actually the interior black region is the true object here since background isn't excluded: interior 6x6 (even) fills with 2, interior 3x3 (odd) with 7, interior 8x8 (even) with 2, interior 5x5 (odd) with 7. I'm also confirming that the irregular black background and blue borders aren't square shapes, so they're excluded from this rule.
